entries.insertion_ready_paragraph: Uttam Mohanty later recalled meeting Meher while home in Baripada. He had been reluctant to act, but Meher photographed him and offered him the role in Abhiman. After seeking his family's agreement, Mohanty joined the production; he remembered completing it in35days. The recollection gives Meher's directing career a concrete beginning in casting and working with a newcomer.
